name: Barnaby Brooks Jr.
original_name: バーナビー・ブルックスJr.
source:
A rookie hero who does not conceal his appearance or identity and is the newest addition to Hero TV. Partnered with Wild Tiger, he has the same power, though Barnaby relies more on strategy than outright brute force, saving his Hundred Power for the most dire of circumstances.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Tiger_%26_Bunny_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
